name: David InterContinental Tel Aviv
positioning: Seaside InterContinental (officially InterContinental David Tel Aviv) by the Mediterranean, between Neve Tzedek and Old Jaffa, where most rooms look out to sea
best_for: Travelers who want sea views and a base steps from Tel Aviv's beachfront promenade
Families wanting a kids' pool and connecting rooms
Guests who value a club lounge high above the Mediterranean

facts.text: The hotel sits by the Mediterranean Sea, Neve Tzedek and Old Jaffa.
Neve Tzedek, the Carmel Market and Jaffa are close by.
Rooms have marble bathrooms, a work desk and a sitting area.
Terrace rooms have sea views from generous private balconies.
The Club lounge offers check-in and check-out, breakfast, afternoon tea, all-day refreshments and evening drinks with canapes.
The Atrium Lobby Bar sits in the middle of a spacious lobby with 27-meter-high ceilings.
Pastries by Alon Shabo, one of Israel's leading pastry chefs, are served at the Atrium Lobby Bar.
SPICE is a cocktail bar with a vintage ambiance inspired by an old world apothecary.
A kids' pool offers a shaded, secure play area.
Young travelers have a dedicated check-in area at reception and welcome amenities.
Large connecting rooms are available for families.
Guests can enjoy Adanim Tea, a family-owned Israeli tea house crafting organic blends since 1982.

highlights.text: More than 90% of the rooms have Mediterranean Sea views.
The Club InterContinental lounge is on the 24th floor with views of the Mediterranean Sea.
THE Spa has seven treatment rooms, including a couples' suite, plus saunas and a relaxation space.
The outdoor pool has Mediterranean views.
The Tayelet, Tel Aviv's beachfront promenade from Tel Aviv Port to Jaffa, is steps from the hotel.

considerations.text: Kids' activities at the hotel are seasonal.
